title: Adds retention policy cancellation reason to Subscriptions
changed: canceled_by_retention_policy added to Subscription.cancellation_details.reason, replacing cancellation_requested for test subscriptions the retention policy cancels
reason: subscription.cancellation_details is a nullable `anyOf` reference in the recorded contracts, and the analyzer resolves nested schemas only through direct `$ref`s (analyzer.ts referencedPropertySchema), so reads, switches and literal compares below it are not traced: nothing is reported, with or without fullDiff.
